explication: LightGBM is a gradient-boosted decision-tree framework. Users submit tabular data and parameters through the CLI, Python, R, or C API; the runtime parses and materializes datasets, computes objective gradients, grows trees, evaluates metrics, and writes a model. A predictor later loads that model and produces scores. Python also exposes cross-validation, scikit-learn, and Dask workflows. The graph reflects documented capabilities and sampled implementations; some wrapper-to-native calls are inferred from the exposed API structure.
